classification.title: App throws NullPointerException on every login attempt
classification.body: Stack trace points to the session middleware. Started right after upgrading to v3.2.0. Reproducible 100% of the time on staging.

classification.title: Add support for exporting reports as PDF
classification.body: Currently only HTML export exists. Several customers have asked for a downloadable PDF version for sharing with stakeholders.

classification.title: What's the recommended way to run this behind a reverse proxy?
classification.body: I'm trying to deploy behind nginx and getting 502s on WebSocket upgrade. Is there a documented config for this?

classification.title: Same OOM crash as the one reported last week
classification.body: Getting the exact same out-of-memory crash under load that was already reported — just confirming it's still happening on v3.3.1.

classification.title: Update CI runner image to ubuntu-24.04
classification.body: Routine maintenance — current runner image is EOL soon. No functional change expected.

classification.title: Database connection pool exhausted under moderate load
classification.body: After ~200 concurrent connections the pool never releases idle connections back, eventually all new requests hang. Happens consistently in load testing, not yet seen in prod.

classification.title: Allow custom branding/logo in the dashboard header
classification.body: We white-label this product for clients and need to swap the logo without forking the repo. A config option or asset override would work.

classification.title: Does this support multi-region deployments?
classification.body: Looking to deploy across us-east and eu-west for latency reasons. Is that a supported topology today or roadmap only?

classification.title: CSV export drops rows with commas in the description field
classification.body: Any description containing a comma gets truncated or shifts columns in the exported CSV — looks like fields aren't being quoted/escaped.

classification.title: Bump lodash to patch a known CVE
classification.body: Dependabot flagged a moderate-severity CVE in a transitive lodash version. Straightforward version bump, no API changes used.

classification.title: Dropdown menu closes immediately when clicked on Firefox
classification.body: On Firefox 128, clicking the account dropdown opens and instantly closes it — looks like a click-outside handler firing on the same click that opened it. Chrome/Safari unaffected.

classification.title: Add keyboard shortcuts for common actions
classification.body: Power users have asked for shortcuts like 'n' for new item, '/' for search focus, similar to Linear/GitHub's shortcut patterns.

classification.title: Is there a rate limit on the public API and where is it documented?
classification.body: Getting occasional 429s and can't find the actual limits in the docs — requests/min, burst allowance, etc.

classification.title: Reported this exact race condition already in issue about concurrent writes
classification.body: This looks identical to the previously-reported concurrent-write race condition — same symptom, same trigger (two simultaneous PATCH requests).

classification.title: Clean up unused feature-flag code from the 2025 rollout
classification.body: The gradual-rollout flags for last year's redesign are all at 100% now and can be deleted — pure cleanup, no behavior change.

classification.title: Search results are missing items that clearly match the query
classification.body: Searching for 'invoice' returns 3 results but there are at least 12 items with 'invoice' in the title. Seems like the index isn't being updated on create, only on explicit reindex.

classification.title: Support SSO via SAML in addition to OAuth
classification.body: Our enterprise customers require SAML for compliance reasons. OAuth-only is a blocker for a few deals in the pipeline.

classification.title: Why did my webhook stop firing after a config change?
classification.body: Webhooks were working fine, then I updated the retry policy setting and they silently stopped. No error in logs. Not sure if this is a bug or I misconfigured something.

classification.title: Timezone handling bug: scheduled jobs run an hour early after DST change
classification.body: All cron-scheduled jobs shifted an hour earlier right after the DST transition. Looks like cached UTC offsets aren't being recalculated.

classification.title: Refactor the config-loading module for clarity
classification.body: No functional change — the config loader has accumulated a lot of special-casing over time and could use a cleanup pass. Not urgent.

classification.title: Add a dry-run flag to the CLI's migrate command
classification.body: Would like to preview what a migration will do before actually running it against production data — a lot of tools support --dry-run for exactly this.

classification.title: Intermittent 500 errors on the /export endpoint only
classification.body: About 1 in 20 requests to /export return a 500 with no useful error message; retrying usually succeeds. Other endpoints unaffected. Started sometime in the last week, no deploy correlates obviously.

classification.title: Is the roadmap for Q3 published anywhere public?
classification.body: Trying to plan our integration work and would like to know what's coming so we don't build something that conflicts.

classification.title: Duplicate of the memory leak in the file-upload handler
classification.body: This is the same leak already tracked elsewhere — steady memory growth on repeated large uploads, never released.

classification.title: Pin the Docker base image digest instead of a floating tag
classification.body: Currently pulling `node:20-slim` which can silently change under us. Pinning to a digest makes builds reproducible. No behavior change intended.
